blocks.title: Arbitrary arguments
blocks.text: When the number of arguments that will be passed to a function is not known in advance, *args and **kwargs can be used to handle such cases.

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)
blocks.text:
def add_numbers(*args):
....return sum(args)    # sum() adds the values

print(add_numbers(1, 2, 3))    # 6
print(add_numbers(4, 5))       # 9
